title: File:Accidental death or murder of a Bulgarian broadcaster,October1978? Vladimir Simeonov lived and died here, Plaistow, London E13.jpg
desc:
In 1978 the Bulgarian Vladimir Dimitriov Simeonov - владимир симеонов - was found dead here aged 30....
Also in 1978, Georgi Markov was killed by being stabbed in the thigh by an umbrella tipped with ricin poison,injected inside a tiny drilled ball, at a bus stop on Waterlook bridge on September 7,d
